answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns only after paid work with 12 unrelated counterparties over 20 epochs. A sparrow-sized newcomer earns trust one trade at a time; a gale of fakes cannot fake that web, since each trade costs 5 coins. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades costing 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin pool; a spiral of reused partners is flagged by the public graph as a star cluster. Honest agents pay once.
